review.notes: Full re-review. The three findings, four corrections and three format notes of the previous review are repaired. One finding (P2): the route of 3.2 calls the interval kernels for two boundary conditions mutually absolutely continuous; they are mutually singular, and the source's Lemma 6.43 is a bound on cylinder events. Checked: all 13 sampled sections against Friedli-Velenik (41 locators, authors' revised version; printed pages not verifiable); Ruelle, Koralov-Sinai, Ellis and Grimmett not readable. Adversarial table with computed values for every section and headline. Supplier citations resolved on main (DimerModelsAndLozengeTilings 4.1-4.6) and at the open head of BernoulliPercolation (5.1, 6.1, 6.2); dependency check 0 problems. Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry as the only warning (33); signatures compared; one-tactic probe closes none. Automatic checks: two scanner hits set aside as false positives (a code span wrapping a line; a roadmap named as a different notion, not a supplier).
